text_block_list.text:
Okay, Эйр Грув! It's time for you and me
to do our best dancin'!
Hoooold! And lift!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
Perfect! Then, I'll cast confetti into the air,
and it will fall like
snowflakes of gold and
silver! A deep and moving performance
this
will be!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's calm down a little! That concert
has gotten you both way
too excited!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Heh. Well, I can say with much joy and
confidence, their sustained
excitement is a
clear result of how meaningful the
commemorative
concert was.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I received lots of messages from the
folks back home saying
they were all
happy to see it, even though they couldn't
attend in
person.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
So, I think we should eat a lot to celebrate
how successful the event
was at making
everyone happy.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Ha...hahaha, that's right! Ah, but, I would
appreciate it if you
practiced a bit of
restraint in your celebration.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: ...Hey.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Brian. ♪ What did you think of the
concert? Which of my
songs touched your
heart?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Maybe "Endless Dream!!"? Your song
"BLAZE" was pretty—
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
No. Listen, eat some more meat. You won't
grow any muscle if you
only eat sweets.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Typical Brian! We're supposed to be
having fun, you know!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
And? Concerts and parties are rewards for
running. If you wanna
attend another,
you'd better be fit to fight for it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Now then, I want to express my thanks to
you both for your hard work
in preparing
the commemorative concert and today's
after-party.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I hate to interrupt, President. However, I
received notice from a track
attendant
saying they spotted students out running
while they were
supposed to be at the
party.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: I also see your name here, Brian. Care to enlighten me as to why?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Haha! No, no, it's all right. I had
considered warning the students not
to get
too swept up in the party mood, but there
was no need.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The fall G1 season will begin soon—and it
seems everyone is
preparing to forge their
futures.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The curtain has fallen on the radiant stage,
and the sound of cheers
has settled down.
Soon, the gate to another heart-stopping
race will
open!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
